_doc: What you care about, in three tiers that mean different things. established: what you follow and enjoy; most time goes here, to stay relevant. growth: what you want to understand because it develops you; steady, slow progress. exploration: what you haven't explored yet; optional but always present, for worthwhile surprises. Edit by hand or tell Claude (prompts/update_interests.md). Dimensions tag every item; sources and arXiv categories live in config/sources.json.

research.name: Researcher
research.description: Become a strong researcher: foundations, research taste, independent ideas, experiments, critical reading, explaining research.

knowledge.name: Knowledge Explorer
knowledge.description: Broad and deep knowledge beyond your own field: mathematics, sciences, history, philosophy, psychology, economics, preferring connections between fields.

world.name: World Radar
world.description: Understand what is happening at home and in the world: what happened, why it matters, what to watch.

people.name: People and Self
people.description: Emotional intelligence, empathy, listening, communication, courage, leadership, boundaries and self-understanding, through real-world practice.

culture.name: Culture and Life
culture.description: A rich life outside work: literature, philosophy, anime, film, music, art, architecture, photography, theatre, travel and experiences.

curiosity.name: Curiosity, Discovery and Making
curiosity.description: Better questions and conversations, unusual ideas, new experiences, practical skills and making things.

established._doc: Topics you repeatedly enjoy or actively follow: AI and AI research, plus the foundations that build it.
ai_research: AI agents: planning, memory, tool use and multi-agent systems
world models (JEPA, latent dynamics, video and interactive world models)
graph neural networks and geometric deep learning
information retrieval, search and recommender systems
AI for science (protein structure, AlphaFold-style models)

growth._doc: Topics you want to understand because they make you a better researcher and person. Worked on slowly, a little at a time.
people_and_self: active listening and asking better questions
taking initiative and making decisions under uncertainty

exploration._doc: Things you haven't explored yet but might find fascinating. Optional, never zero: they keep the mind fresh. world.regions double as places to explore.
culture: languages and literature from different cultures
Japanese culture, etiquette and everyday life

world._doc: Used by World Radar (news) and, for exploration, as places to discover.
regions: small island territories (e.g. Tristan da Cunha)
topics: Indian society, public policy and institutions

cross_domain_favourites: physics <-> machine learning (statistical mechanics, energy-based models, symmetry)
history of science <-> philosophy of science
philosophy of love <-> psychology of relationships
culture_guidance: Recommend for quality, beauty, historical significance, emotional depth or cultural importance, not popularity. Prefer variety across eras, countries and forms; avoid the same mainstream picks.
